widgets.text:
<script>
                (function() {
                    var checkInterval = setInterval(function() {
                        var root = window.moqui?.webrootVue;
                        if (root && root.fields) {
                            clearInterval(checkInterval);
                            
                            // Initialize reactive workspace backpack structure
                            if (!root.backpackArtifacts) {
                                root.backpackArtifacts = { entities: [], services: [], screens: [] };
                            }
                            
                            // Callback to mount selected reference token to active session
                            root.selectBackpackArtifact = function(val) {
                                root.fields.selectedArtifact = val;
                                if (typeof root.handleArtifactSelection === 'function') {
                                    root.handleArtifactSelection(root.fields.targetComponent, val);
                                }
                            };
                            
                            // Watch active component scope changes to refresh the Backpack
                            root.$watch('fields.targetComponent', function(newVal) {
                                if (newVal) {
                                    $.ajax({
                                        url: '/apps/agiide/IdeWorkspace/getArtifactOptions',
                                        data: { targetComponent: newVal },
                                        type: 'GET',
                                        success: function(data) {
                                            if (data && Array.isArray(data)) {
                                                root.backpackArtifacts.entities = data.filter(function(x) { return x.type === 'entity'; });
                                                root.backpackArtifacts.services = data.filter(function(x) { return x.type === 'service'; });
                                                root.backpackArtifacts.screens = data.filter(function(x) { return x.type === 'screen'; });
                                            }
                                        }
                                    });
                                }
                            }, { immediate: true });
                        }
                    }, 200);
                })();
            </script>
